title: A read-only verb ranks the self-timing log by slowest command
action: PBI p-10caed3f (deferral named in docs/knowledge/areas/performance-log/cli-self-timing.md:37-39): record_timing (verbs/mod.rs:95-103) appends {command, ms, ts} lines to .bee/logs/timings.jsonl on every invocation, and nothing aggregates them. Build a read-only report verb: group lines by command name; per command emit count, total ms, median ms, p95 ms, max ms; sort slowest-median first; --limit N (default 15). Registry: check whether a perf group already exists in registry_payload.json — if yes the verb is perf report (or joins the existing perf naming); if no group fits, register timings report; follow the registry's real shape, declare flags (limit + json), keep tests/registry_contracts.rs green and bump the flag-vocabulary pin only if a genuinely new flag name is introduced (limit exists already). Missing or empty log = clean empty report, exit 0. Malformed lines are skipped and their count reported, never fatal. The verb writes nothing (its own record_timing self-line excepted, like every verb). TDD red-first: fixture log with three commands + one malformed line -> ranking order, stats math (median/p95 on known values), malformed count; empty/missing log clean; json and text renders pinned.

truths: the report ranks commands slowest-median-first with count/total/median/p95/max
missing or empty log yields a clean empty report exit 0
malformed lines are skipped and counted, never fatal

artifacts.substantive: verb registered with flags; implementation plus tests in the real verb home, named in the trace

trace.outcome: bee timings report ships: per-command count/total/median/p95/max ranked slowest-median-first, --limit default 15, fail-open jsonl parse with malformed count, wide-door root resolution; 9 tests
deviations: perf group exists but perf.report is a distinct unported Node command with an unrelated schema - joined the cell's fallback and registered the timings group, matching the spec's own deferral wording
